# HOLD FIRE: sound design (cue sheet)

*Generated by `tools/audio/sfx.py` (re-run it after the timing is refined; every time below comes from `render/data/timing.json`). Do not edit by hand.*

## Rules

* **The song is untouched.** The mix is `song + layer`, sample-aligned (sample 0 = the MP3's first decoded sample, encoder delay trimmed: the time base of `timing.json`). No normalising, compression, ducking or limiting of the song. Outside the cue windows the layer is exactly 0.0, so the mix is bit-identical to the song there (null test below).
* **Under the song.** Each cue is levelled against the song's own momentary loudness (BS.1770, 400 ms): it sits at its median target margin under the song and never closer than its worst-frame margin (all well over the 6 dB rule); exempt only: the scope cue before the music starts (song < -40 LUFS, t < 0.61 s) and the end card's tail, after the music has ended (the song falls below the same -40 LUFS for good, t >= 245.97 s).
* **Under the vocal.** Wherever a word is sounding (vocal stem >= -40 LUFS in 100 ms windows and within 12 dB of that word's peak, so onset ramps and tails count as gaps) the whole layer sits >= 6 dB under the vocal (fitted at 7): event cues (pings, thuds, the match) take a lower fixed gain; continuous cues (scope hum/servo, lock, whoosh, wind, the drop's lock) duck under the words with a smoothed gain curve on the layer only. Between words the layer may fill the gap, always under the song.
* **Loudness unchanged.** The mix's integrated loudness must stay within 1 LU of the original master (it is -0.002 LU).
* **Light, not percussion.** Pings are soft-attack glass tones in D minor (the song's key), high and short, far under the whisper. Nothing in the layer peaks above -14 dBFS; the mix never clips.
* **Synced to the picture**, not to a guess: count pings use `coldopen.js pulses()` exactly (n pings at t + i*gap); the lock follows `phases().lock`; the chime the reticle's `open`; the end pings `endcard.js` (period 1.15 s from S).
* **All synthesized** (numpy/scipy, seeded, deterministic). No generated audio was used ($0.00).

## Timing notes

* Timing file: `render/data/timing.json`, status: *final - verified (see analysis/timing.md "Verification"); per-word confidence in words[].conf where not high*
* warning: Intro line 0 word 6 'eight' @ 6.630: no count number (renderer draws no pulse)
* Bridge line 6 ('sixty-two, depth charges falling'): the word times are contiguous, so the pings and thuds are placed in the quietest 20 ms of the vocal stem near each word boundary: sonar1 158.599, sonar2 159.637, thud1 159.905, thud2 160.450; nothing after 161.18 ('two said fire').
* The match flare is at Bridge line 2 start - 0.2 + 0.5 = 149.227 (the brief); the forest scene's `sparkT` is currently `matchT + 0.3` = 149.027. If the spark is drawn there, move one of them.
* The mix is 249.2 s: the end card (Z3) runs to `A.duration + 2`, and `A.duration` falls back to 247.2 because timing.json has no top-level `duration` (the decoded song is 247.160 s, so the tail is 2.04 s).
